math_steps.explanation:
$$\begin{gathered}a=0\\y=-2x+3\\\text{斜率}\ -2<0,\ \text{严格递减}\Rightarrow a=0\ \text{成立}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}a>0:\ \text{开口向上，对称轴}\ x=\frac{1}{a}\\\text{严格递减的部分}:\ x\le \frac{1}{a}\\\left[2, +\infty\right)\not\subseteq \left\{x\mid x\le \frac{1}{a}\right\}\Rightarrow a>0\ \text{舍去}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}a<0:\ \text{开口向下，对称轴}\ x=\frac{1}{a}\\\text{严格递减的部分}:\ x\ge \frac{1}{a}\\a<0\Rightarrow \frac{1}{a}\in \left(-\infty, 0\right)\\\frac{1}{a}\le 2\ \text{恒成立}\Rightarrow a\in \left(-\infty, 0\right)\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 按二次项系数分类

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}a=0:\ \text{成立}\\a>0:\ \text{舍去}\\a<0:\ a\in \left(-\infty, 0\right)\\\text{各类合并}:\ a\in \left(-\infty, 0\right]\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 汇总三类
